description: This file defines the class smpl_Contact_Sample which generates an HTML-based PDF template for Contact information within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to retrieve template content, header, and footer, and references external services for logo URLs and translation functions.

classes.name: smpl_Contact_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate a contact sample PDF template with header, body, and footer.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of data this sample represents, which is 'Contacts'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the contact sample, including logo, contact details, and a descriptive paragraph about the company.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no header content.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Returns an empty string, indicating no footer content.

search-terms: PHP class for SuiteCRM PDF template
